Several donor management software options offer native integrations with QuickBooks (Online and/or Desktop) to automate syncing of donations, transactions, and donor data, eliminating manual entry.[1][2][3][4][5][6][7]

### Key Options and Features
| Software | QuickBooks Versions Supported | Sync Details | Cost Notes |
|----------|-------------------------------|--------------|------------|
| **Donorbox** | QuickBooks Online | Auto-syncs one-time/recurring donations, ticket sales as Sales Receipts or Invoices + Payments; setup wizard maps campaigns to accounts.[1] | $50/month add-on to Donorbox plan.[1] |
| **DonorSnap** | QuickBooks Online & Desktop (PC) | Batch transfers transactions; matches accounting codes/payment methods; prevents duplicates; no extra cost.[2] | Free with DonorSnap.[2] |
| **DonorDock** | QuickBooks Online (Desktop via export/import) | Auto-syncs donations as sales receipts; links gift numbers for navigation.[4] | Not specified (native integration).[4] |
| **Method:Donor** | All QuickBooks versions | Two-way, real-time sync of donations, donors, follow-ups, and history.[5] | Not specified.[5] |
| **DonorPerfect** | QuickBooks Online & Desktop | Syncs gifts/pledges/expenses; customizable mapping (e.g., to customers, classes); filters for posted/unposted; audit trail.[6][7][8][9] | Not specified (cloud-based option available via DonorPerfect).[7] |

These tools focus on nonprofits, streamlining fundraising with features like donor tracking, reporting, and campaign management alongside QuickBooks for accurate financials.[3] For setup, most involve authorizing access, mapping accounts, and configuring sync rules (e.g., real-time or batch).[1][2][6] Evaluate based on your QuickBooks version, real-time needs, and scale—DonorPerfect and DonorSnap support both Online/Desktop.[3][6]
